column1: # Vanilla procs whose build-241 signature differs from build 211 and that GadScape's own scripts or interfaces call.
# Calls and hooks from custom content are redirected to a small adapter script: it takes the 211 arguments, pushes
# what the 241 proc takes, calls it and drops the int results the 211 callers do not expect.
#   argmap "-": the adapter passes the 211 int args in order, then extraInts (ScriptTrailer.adapter; byte-identical to
#               the adapters of the hand-built cacheU).
#   argmap "INTS|OBJS": one entry per 241 argument: iN / oN = the adapter's (the 211 caller's) int / object arg N, a
#               number = that int constant (for an argument 241 inserted in the middle).
# The step checks every row against the caches (211 args in USER, 241 args in the output) and fails on a stale row.
# A signature change with no row here makes the converter port the 211 version of the proc instead (with a warning).
# Adapter ids 46000/46001 are the ones the hand-built cacheU used; 46002+ are free in BASE and USER too.

column8: create_graphic: 241 adds the tiling flag as the last arg (211 always called cc_settiling(1)) and returns the next child id (cs_2746: iload1 iconst1 add return)
2064: 241 turned the 211 constant 9 (instruction 9, "iconst 9") into a new int arg 1 and shifted the old arg 1 to arg 2; the rest only renumbers locals and remaps 109:54 -> 109:60
scrollbar_horizontal: 241 adds a flag that gates the onscrollwheel hook (211 always set it: pass 1)

4218: same arguments, but 241 rewrote it (17 instructions, gosub 7137) and it now returns an int the 211 version did not; GadScape script 32000 calls it as a statement, so the adapter drops the result
